name: HTTPS request-response
evidence: WCF-WebHttp maps SubmitNotice to POST /notices and the orchestration sends ShipmentAck on the same two-way port.

name: Validation and enrichment
evidence: Expr_ValidateAndComputeEta invokes supplied helper code for validation and business-day ETA calculation.

name: Response mapping
evidence: Map_ShipmentNotice_To_ShipmentAck maps identifiers and UTC receipt time; orchestration assigns final status and ETA.

name: Conditional archive
evidence: Decide_NoticeAccepted sends the original notice to SP_HarborLane_Shipments_Archive only when isValid is true.

name: Transport retry
evidence: The archive FILE send port specifies RetryCount 3 and RetryInterval 5; ordered delivery and stop-on-failure are false.
